desc: A start while another mode runs asks instead of refusing: on a Paper Tower floor, the Start menu's Modes > Battles > Fight (Lord Crump's refight) says "Press A again to leave The Paper Tower and start Boss refights"; A leaves the climb (the menu closes) and the refight begins once Mario is back
